tasks.title: TASK 1A: Location: Baie St. Paul City Centre
tasks.statement:
In addition to the beautiful physical landscapes, the citizens here also appreciate aspects of human geography, particularly how their unique culture and values create a special type of urban landscape. In a recent survey, Baie-Saint-Paul citizens voted the downtown area as the most representative landscape of their region, and also one of their favourites. The local history of art is a key element of the cultural heritage of the city, and forms the basis of the tourism industry.
Your task is:
• to explore the downtown area by following the route drawn in red on Map A1
• to complete an inventory of cultural heritage that reflects the art and historical culture that is so important to this city. (Map A2 – on a separate sheet)
• to identify the areas that are not attractive and so reduce a tourist’s appreciation of the city’s culture and landscape. (Map A3).

parts.question: On your walk, observe and map your observations on Map A2 (separate sheet). You will need to decide what symbols you will use. You may label and annotate your map. Mark features on your map (statues, other features reflecting art culture, history, businesses) and list the types of features you observe in Table A1.

Identify three spaces or features that are not attractive, and could reduce a tourist’s appreciation of the city’s cultural landscape. Describe these areas in Table A2. Record the location of each of these three areas on Map A3.
On Map A3, draw the boundary between the tourist and residential areas. Use a dashed line to indicate the boundary.

tasks.title: TASK 1B: Location: Boisé du Quai
tasks.statement:
The local landscape is very important to the citizens and to the tourists of Baie-Saint-Paul. The citizens have said:
• this area is their favourite landscape
• they love access to the river
• they want to both protect and develop this important landscape.
Explore the area, keeping within the area indicated on Map B1.

parts.question: Identify, outline, and label on MAP B1 the seven main land cover/vegetation types for the areas which are numbered on the map and complete Table B1 to describe how each area is currently being used and the value of the area.

Observe any signs of damage or disturbance to this environment. Mark them on Map B2, annotate what the damage is and whether it is natural/human, and list natural conditions or human interventions that minimize erosion in Table B2.
a. What evidence do you see that this area is an estuary? b. What marks the boundary between terrestrial and aquatic landscapes here? c. Suggest reasons why a beach has formed at this location.

tasks.title: FIELDWORK EXERCISE 2 - TASK 1: Baie-Saint-Paul
tasks.statement: Based on your results from the fieldwork and the survey results provided, complete the tasks regarding the cultural heritage and landscape zones of Baie-Saint-Paul.

parts.question: Based on your results from Table A1, create 4-6 categories that represent the cultural heritage that you found in the town. Please keep the statues as a separate category. List the categories in Table C1 and indicate which features belong in each class or category.

Using your rough map from the fieldwork (Map A2) and the classification from Table C1, create a neat map on the template (Map C1 separate sheet) including artist statues, types and locations of other features/businesses, a legend, and a scale.

On the map you have drawn, Map C1, delineate the zones of cultural heritage landscape: A. The CORE AREA, B. The PERIPHERY AREA, C. Areas requiring immediate attention (the three areas identified yesterday).
Using citizens' survey responses as a basis, suggest one way in which each of the spaces you identified in question 3C could be improved.

Choose one area you have marked as PERIPHERY on your map that would be the best area to expand the CORE area into, label it '1', and explain what developments would need to happen for it to become part of the CORE.

tasks.title: FIELDWORK EXERCISE 2 - TASK 2: Boisé du Quai – Bay Area
tasks.statement: The Bay area is the favourite landscape of the citizens of Baie-Saint-Paul. They want to develop the recreation facilities and increase protection of the area. Read the responses to the survey in Tables C2, C3, C4, C5 and C6. Consider the citizens' responses to the survey, and your own knowledge about the different environments at this site.

parts.question: Design a land use plan for the Boisé du Quai area on the template map provided (Map C2) reflecting community goals in development/protection, allowing easy access, including a heavy use recreational space, and indicating sensitive areas to be protected. Annotate your suggestions to justify your choices.
